claims.claim: The Nike Factory Store at OKC Outlets on I-40 is the value sell-through door for the Under $100 line.
claims.evidence: TravelOK lists Nike Factory Store among the tenants of OKC Outlets, 7624 W Reno Ave at I-40 exit 142 (Council Rd). iExit's I-40 exit 142 directory lists Nike Factory Store - Oklahoma City at 7654 W Reno Ave. Neither listing is dated, so current hours still need a call.

claims.claim: Shop Good is on N Broadway in Midtown and is the tastemaker door for the Red Dirt capsule and District series.

sources.title: Shop Good - Service Providers - MetroFamily Magazine

claims.evidence: Listings place Shop Good at 1007 N Broadway Ave in Automobile Alley, not Midtown. It is a family-run shop that screen prints its own shirts in the store and sells gifts and home goods. One listing says it is open seven days a week.
claims.action: Relabeled Shop Good's neighborhood from Midtown to Automobile Alley in strategy.json (Red Dirt capsule where, partners, retail playbook), retail-landscape.json and the factcheck.json notes.

claims.claim: The Thunder's home opener is Oct 22 vs. Denver at Paycom Center.

sources.title: Thunder tip off 26-27 season at Spurs on NBC, then host Nuggets in home opener

claims.evidence: The Thunder open at San Antonio on Oct 20 on NBC, then host Denver in the home opener at Paycom Center on Thursday, Oct 22, at 8:30 p.m. Central on ESPN.
claims.action: Removed the stale hedges: calendar entry 1 in strategy.json now names Oct 22 as the home opener at Paycom Center, and fanbase.json names the date. Factcheck verdict set to confirmed.

claims.claim: Oklahoma's sales-tax holiday falls on the first weekend of August and covers clothing and shoes under $100 per item.

sources.title: Oklahoma's Sales Tax Holiday for 2025 happening this weekend

claims.evidence: Local reports say the holiday runs on the first weekend of August and exempts clothing and footwear priced under $100 per item. The 2025 holiday ran Aug 1-3 and the 2026 holiday Aug 7-9. Athletic gear such as cleats and sports uniforms is excluded. No 2027 dates were found.
claims.action: No change needed in the research. Factcheck verdicts set to confirmed; the 2027 dates still need the Tax Commission's notice.

corrections.correction: Shop Good is at 1007 N Broadway in Automobile Alley.
